title: Canadian MDA Space Secures €64 Million IRIS2 Antenna Agreement
summary:
Canadian space technology company MDA Space has signed an agreement with Thales Alenia Space to begin work on digital antennas for the first 66 satellites of the European Union’s IRIS2 secure connectivity constellation.
